claims.note: Bitcoin contributed 700,903 of the 2,205,430 total revenue increase (31.78%), not a majority (>50%). Subscription and services-based revenue was the largest contributor at 55.32%.

Revenue component changes sum to the reported total revenue change (residual=0). Gross profit component changes including amortization of acquired technology assets sum to the reported gross profit change (residual=0).

The filing states Bitcoin revenue fluctuates with both customer demand and bitcoin market price (c03:s03), but provides no separate numerical breakdown isolating the price effect from volume/demand effects.
